study_type: One-seed exploratory LoRA adaptation diagnostic; not confirmatory and not an exact reproduction of the published full-parameter experiment.
research_question: On the locked TOFU profile development cohort, does a fixed IDK+AP objective produce forget-set uncertainty while keeping retain-answer quality within the existing 5 percentage-point utility margins?
motivation: A prior NPO+retain-NLL run failed forget Truth Ratio and retain ROUGE-L gates. This is a new method chosen before this run; no new alpha or learning-rate search will be performed.

limitations: TOFU profile blocks are inferred from contiguous groups of 20 rows because the published files do not expose a structured author ID.
The published full checkpoint was already fine-tuned on the TOFU training data; this protocol measures adapter effects relative to that checkpoint.
This follow-up uses a subset of the benchmark and is not a standard full-split TOFU leaderboard run.

Reuses the locked dev/final profile assignments from the prior preregistered TOFU cohort design; dev profiles have been observed in earlier NPO work, so this is a method diagnostic, not a fresh confirmatory test.

objective.name: IDK+AP
objective.forget_loss: mean token cross-entropy for a fixed sampled official IDK answer on each forget prompt
objective.upstream_loss_reduction: Forget IDK loss uses model outputs.loss (mean over scored tokens); AP compares per-example summed response-token NLLs, averages paired examples, and divides by beta.

training.method: IDK+AP objective with LoRA adapters; resource-adapted, not the paper exact full-parameter run
training.scheduler: linear with one training epoch of warmup
training.precision: FP16 frozen base checkpoint; FP32 LoRA and loss; SDPA
training.retain_pairing: For each forget row, deterministically sample one retain row with replacement from the optimizer-only retain profile pool and one fixed IDK response; use the same retain question/IDK response pair in AP for all epochs.
training.hardware: Kaggle GPU T4 x2, sharded model, no CPU/disk offload
training.initialization_and_smoke: Run one bounded real-data optimizer update, verify finite loss/gradients and nonzero LoRA change, restore the exact initial LoRA tensors, reset optimizer/sampler state, then begin the locked run without reloading model weights.

bootstrap.unit: profile block, paired by source row index

evaluation.research_claim_limit: One-seed, previously seen development cohort, LoRA adaptation; result is exploratory and cannot establish general effectiveness or reproduce the paper.

development_gates.forget10.truth_ratio_score: lower bound of paired profile-block bootstrap 95% CI for candidate minus full checkpoint must be > 0
development_gates.forget10.answer_probability: upper bound of paired profile-block bootstrap 95% CI for candidate minus full checkpoint must be < 0
development_gates.retain90.answer_probability: lower bound of paired profile-block bootstrap 95% CI for candidate minus full checkpoint must be > -0.05
development_gates.retain90.rougeL_recall: lower bound of paired profile-block bootstrap 95% CI for candidate minus full checkpoint must be > -0.05
development_gates.holdout10.answer_probability: lower bound of paired profile-block bootstrap 95% CI for candidate minus full checkpoint must be > -0.05

decision_rule.if_all_development_gates_pass: Run exactly one final-cohort training/evaluation with identical hyperparameters and the disjoint final profile blocks; do not tune based on final metrics.
decision_rule.if_any_development_gate_fails: Stop; do not train on or evaluate the final cohort under this protocol.
decision_rule.idk_marker_rates: Descriptive only. A fixed lexical marker and exact-string screen; not a semantic refusal/factuality judgment and not a pass gate.

stopping_rules: Verify all pinned TOFU and IDK file hashes, row counts, profile assignments, evaluation reference lineage, and split disjointness before model loading.
Verify IDK and AP losses and gradients against the pinned official source before model loading.
Run exactly one bounded real-data smoke update and restore LoRA initialization before the research training loop.
Do not alter the single locked method or hyperparameters after training begins.
Do not run final profiles unless all five development gates pass.
Any runtime failure is an engineering failure, not a research result; preserve logs and receipts.
